MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None felt like a natural next choice: the recognizable collections did not connect strongly enough to the Christmas music and vocal arrangements in my recent listening.",
    "Being another music album is not enough to interest me; I would need a clearer connection to the sound I have been choosing.",
    "Titles such as Very Best Of and Greatest Hits leave me unable to identify the artist or judge whether the music fits my interests."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The selections seem to assume that listening to familiar albums means I want broadly familiar pop and greatest-hits collections.",
    "The word Classic in my Christmas listening does not mean I am seeking older hits across unrelated performers."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my earlier choices explicitly centered on Christmas, making that a stronger connection than simply being another album.",
    "My latest choice, The New Old Fashioned, also matters: I would be more interested in music connected to its vocal arrangements than in an unrelated retrospective.",
    "My Christmas selections were clustered in November, so they suggest a seasonal interest rather than proof that I want holiday music all year."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The selections recognized my interest in music but missed the specific vocal and seasonal connections that would make me choose another album."
}
